newsitem.title: TURKEY: UN's Iraq weapons inspector in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: UN's Iraq weapons inspector in Turkey.

text.p: United Nations arms envoy Rolf Ekeus arrived in Turkey on Tuesday for talks on the elimination of Iraq's weapons of mass destruction, a Turkish foreign ministry official said.
The official said Ekeus had been invited by the foreign ministry and would discuss with Turkish officials the latest developments in neighbouring Iraq.

Ekeus, who heads the U.N. Special Commission in charge of destroying Iraq's weapons of mass destruction, said in Baghdad on Sunday he was not yet satisfied that all banned weapons had been eliminated.
The U.N. Security Council will hold a bi-monthly review of the sanctions against Iraq on March 3.
The sanctions imposed after the Gulf War in 1991 require Baghdad to dispose of all weapons of mass destruction before the embargo on Iraqi oil exports can be completely lifted.
